g.text: TVTrac is an intelligent entertainment tracker engineered for real-time episode progress,
watchlist synchronization, and algorithmic discovery across 800,000+ films and series.
Powered by Next.js 16 App Router and TMDB REST endpoints, it provides seamless cached feeds,
sub-second search responses, and granular season-by-season completion statistics.
Normalized client-side state caching with Redux Toolkit minimizing redundant network roundtrips.
Instant toggle architecture logging watch status, air dates, and series progression milestones.
Smart algorithmic filters matching user viewing history with genre tags and critical scores.
Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided.
